cohort: 80 fixed development patients; 5 frozen folds; FIT and validation only

training.objective: patient-equal weighted BCE; EZ=2; NEZ=1; mean patient losses

selection.sf1: original A1 VLOO, other 12 choose epoch and threshold by Macro-F1, EZ-F1, BA, threshold distance to 0.5, earlier epoch
selection.srank: other 12 first choose epoch by mean patient EZ-AUPRC, EZ-MRR, EZ-AUROC, earlier epoch; then threshold by Macro-F1, EZ-F1, BA, distance to 0.5

context.source_gate: A-D required and (E or F): SRANK AUPRC >= +0.010, >=4/5 positive folds, MRR nondecreasing, SF1 Macro-F1 >= -0.005, and either frozen T0 same direction or >=20% less 25%-dropout instability with high-channel-count concentration

variants: OBJ1 A1 + fixed within-patient EZ-vs-NEZ pairwise ranking
objective.gate: SRANK AUPRC >= +0.010; >=4/5 positive folds; MRR and Top1 nondecreasing; SF1 Macro-F1 >= -0.005

center.gate: overall AUPRC >= -0.005; worst-center AUPRC >= +0.020 and Macro-F1 >= +0.010; AUPRC gap decreases >=20%; LZU or pediatric improves without substantial other-center collapse; overall Macro-F1 >= -0.005

view.gate: VIEW2 AUPRC >= VIEW0 +0.010 and >= VIEW1 +0.010; >=4/5 and >=3/5 positive folds respectively; MRR nondecreasing vs both; SF1 Macro-F1 >= VIEW0 -0.005

public_data_policy: aggregate CSV/JSON/MD and code only; no patient or channel records, embeddings, predictions, raw cache, checkpoints, or runtime logs
